title: fix(web): let an org with no plan link itself to the org that pays

summaries.body:
<!-- maple-pr-review 4e55ec2a-422a-41cc-989e-ec98d3557874 0 -->
## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 9/10** · safe to merge
A two-line route exemption in the plan gate, pinned by a new plan-gate test; only the new link copy itself is untested.
<sub>no findings · tests partial −1 · risk medium</sub>

Lets an org with no plan open Settings → Billing through the plan gate, and points both plan pickers at that page with a "billed through another organization" link. The exemption is narrow and tested; safe to merge.

- `isAllowedWithoutPlan` exempts `Settings` with `tab=billing` from the plan redirect
- `billThroughAnotherOrgLink` adds the billing-settings link under both plan pickers

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- Exemption is keyed on `_tag === "Settings" && tab === "billing"`; every other settings tab still redirects (`plan-gate.ts:74`)
- The billing tab is visible to any Clerk viewer (`page/settings/nav.ts:103`), so `syncTab` does not rewrite the URL and bounce the org back to `/settings`
- `followRedirects` reads the gate off `model.route` (`update.ts:676`), so the query-string tab the exemption keys on is the one the user navigated to

</details>

<sub>`124a68f` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.</sub>
